# WorldClock

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/scene/world.h`](../../../src/scene/world.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

A world's fixed tick and decision window

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `dt` | `double` | 1 / physics_hz (1/60) |
| `decision_period` | `uint32_t` | ticks per decision: physics_hz / control_hz |
| `tick` | `uint64_t` | ticks done |

## Notes

Emplaced by World from the template's clock block; tick advanced by World::tick.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalChecks](../systems/AnimalChecks.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[AnimalGaitPlayer](../systems/AnimalGaitPlayer.md)**
  - Reads the species' files from the animal library in init.
  - Moves the ragdoll's kinematic Jolt bodies every tick.
  - Logs an error when the walk cannot be played.
- **[AnimalRewards](../systems/AnimalRewards.md)**
  - Teleports the ragdoll's Jolt bodies on a reset.
  - Logs a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.
- **[AnimalTermination](../systems/AnimalTermination.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
- **[Pursuit](../systems/Pursuit.md)**
  - Entity creation and destruction: every runner's end destroys its entity and creates a new one (a new agent id).
- **[Rewards](../systems/Rewards.md)**
  - At a reset: the walker's and the Ground boxes' Jolt bodies are moved and mass properties changed; logs a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.
- **[Sandbox](../systems/Sandbox.md)**
  - Reads resources/agents/params/life.params.json (or `life`), resources/agents/params/animal.params.json, the generated bodies resources/animals/bodies/<id>.body.json and resources/agents/rewards/<id>.rewards.json (hashes kept); throws std::runtime_error on a missing life file, an unknown species or a weapon segment the body lacks.
  - Builds a Jolt ragdoll per animal (bodies and constraints in the animal collision layer, group = its ragdoll group), destroys it when the animal leaves or grows; four static wall boxes round the arena.
  - Installs SandboxSys::Contacts as the PhysicsSystem's contact listener: it records the estimated impulse of every contact between two ragdolls (from Jolt's threads, under a mutex) for SandboxLife.
  - Creates and destroys entities: animals, minds, drawn shapes and grass tiles.
  - Logs one debug line per species at init (count, bodies, standing muzzle height, reward terms and round).
- **[SandboxLife](../systems/SandboxLife.md)**
  - Drains the contact listener's recorded events (the listener is SandboxSys's).
- **[SandboxObserve](../systems/SandboxObserve.md)**
  - On a RESET: every animal and its ragdoll destroyed and the population drawn again (entities and Jolt bodies created and destroyed).
- **[SphereControl](../systems/SphereControl.md)**
  - Adds a torque to the sphere's Jolt body every tick the held torque is not zero.
  - At a reset teleports the Jolt body and builds the marching cubes colliders around the spawn point synchronously.
  - Logs an error in init when the world does not hold exactly one SphereAgent + Transform + RigidBody entity.
- **[SphereObserve](../systems/SphereObserve.md)**
  - Three downward ray casts against the world's static bodies per window.
  - At a trainer RESET, teleports the Jolt body and builds the spawn column's colliders.
- **[Task](../systems/Task.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[Termination](../systems/Termination.md)**
  - Parking skips PhysicsStep and the other non-observe systems of the world until the observe phase.
- **[TrackActions](../systems/TrackActions.md)**
  - Reads resources/<track>.track.json and its .track.bin; throws AssetError for another body or another dt.
  - Moves the kinematic Jolt bodies of the walker.
- **[TrainHost](../systems/service-TrainHost.md)**
  - gRPC client of the ML-Agents trainer (MlAgentsClient on localhost:<port>); reads the environment parameters and engine configuration side channels.
  - Files: envparams.txt (-envParamsOut, written on change), .demo (record-demo), eval summaries (var.out), replays (<prefix>.track.*, .replay.*, .sandbox.*, .grass.bin), legs CSV, cot_out, demo checks JSON.
  - tf::Executor workers for bench, eval and the worlds' steps.
  - Restarts the worlds with the trainer's seed (ScenarioRunner::restart) when the trainer connects in mode=train.
  - Logs the mode's progress and summaries; exit codes 0 (QUIT, stop signal), 1 (bad arguments), 2 (connection lost).
- **[World](../systems/service-Game.md)**
  - Creates the template's entities in World::init through the registered component emplacers.
  - One Jolt job system per world (single threaded with threads 1); Worlds::step runs worlds in parallel on an executor.
- **[WorldStepper](../systems/WorldStepper.md)**
  - Runs every world's fixed systems (physics, agents, ...) on the main thread, sequentially (no executor passed to Worlds::step).
  - Frame dt is clamped to 0.25 s; when more than h is left after 8 ticks the remaining time is dropped (no spiral).
  - ImGui window "Worlds" (world count, tick, h, Pause checkbox, Step button).
- **[WorldTerrain](../systems/WorldTerrain.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in the world's PhysicsWorld, in sorted cell order.
  - CPU marching cubes and FastNoise2 sampling on the world's thread.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit; log warning on a refused mesh.
- **[WorldsEnvironment](../systems/service-WorldsEnvironment.md)**
  - Owns a tf::Executor of `threads` named workers (threads > 1) that steps the worlds in parallel (ScenarioRunner::step).
  - On RESET runs every world's Observe phase alone (SystemSet::fixed_observe_only).
  - Writes the ML-Agents protobuf output: AgentInfos per behaviour, brain parameters with a behaviour's first agents, averaged stats in the stats side channel.
